classification.difficultyReason: Determine each boundary equation from its intercepts, then interpret shading and boundary inclusion.

content.prompt: Write down the inequalities that give these regions.

spec.description: Solid ascending boundary with intercept labels −3 and 3; required region below the boundary. No grid or regular ticks. Source origin O omitted under the graph convention.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph is a permanent student-visible given; printed answer annotation is excluded from the question.

answer.worked:
The intercepts are $(-3,0)$ and $(0,3)$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{3-0}{0-(-3)}\\&=1\end{aligned}$$
The boundary is $y=x+3$. The shaded region is below the solid line, so $y\le x+3$.

spec.description: Solid descending boundary through (0,2) and (1,0); required region above/right of the boundary. No grid or regular ticks. Source origin O omitted under the graph convention.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph is a permanent student-visible given; the incorrect printed answer annotation is excluded from the question.

answer.worked:
The intercepts are $(0,2)$ and $(1,0)$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{0-2}{1-0}\\&=-2\end{aligned}$$
The boundary is $y=-2x+2$. The shaded region is above the solid line, so $y\ge -2x+2$.

spec.description: Dotted descending boundary through (−2,0) and (0,−3); required region below/left of the boundary. No grid or regular ticks. Source origin O omitted under the graph convention.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph is a permanent student-visible given; printed answer annotation is excluded from the question.

answer.worked:
The intercepts are $(-2,0)$ and $(0,-3)$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{-3-0}{0-(-2)}\\&=-\frac32\end{aligned}$$
The boundary is $y=-\frac32x-3$. The shaded region is below the dotted line, so $y< -\frac32x-3$.

spec.description: Dotted ascending boundary through (0,−2) and (5,0); required region above the boundary. No grid or regular ticks. Source origin O omitted under the graph convention.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph is a permanent student-visible given; printed answer annotation is excluded from the question.

answer.worked:
The intercepts are $(0,-2)$ and $(5,0)$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{0-(-2)}{5-0}\\&=\frac25\end{aligned}$$
The boundary is $y=\frac25x-2$. The shaded region is above the dotted line, so $y>\frac25x-2$.
